item_routes.argument: Integrate the channel ODE with two wall values; derive pipe radial Laplacian and exclude its logarithmic mode by C² full-disk regularity; compute fluxes and shear.

Differentiate the punctured-axis vortex and solid rotation; compute circulation and pressure cancellation; use closed-curve chain rule for no global potential and evaluate streamline Bernoulli variation.
Differentiate the radial Stokes field, compute its boundary stress resultant, then apply the imported divergence theorem on bounded annuli under ACω to prove uniqueness in the explicit decay class.
Differentiate the Gaussian tail profile to verify the unsteady equation and prove the exact tail bound; independently advect a smooth periodic loop in a sine shear and integrate its circulation.

Define enthalpy by the EOS integral, prove its gradient formula, dot the smooth Euler momentum equation, and differentiate the parameterized material-loop integral; separately prove the generic vector identity.
Define the classical pointwise constant-density incompressible Euler equations and pressure-only formal stress from explicit Cartesian conventions; no proof/existence claim.
Differentiate the explicit potential, prove harmonicity and slip trace, use the exact identity from x09 for Euler balance, and cancel the pressure resultant by antipodal symmetry.
Substitute the fixed channel and pipe parameters and integrate the exact profiles.
Compute the specified vortex circulation/pressure cancellation and solid-rotation Bernoulli values.
Specialize the exact sphere Stokes field and its formal resultant to a unit sphere and U=e_z.
Evaluate the exact layer tail bound and separate periodic loop formula at the listed parameters.
Verify a uniform barotropic Euler state, enthalpy/Bernoulli value and a translated closed circle.
Specialize the potential to the unit sphere and verify the even pressure and zero resultant.
